title: duplicate treatments
body:
xdrip+ is adding two entries to careportal, one listed as xdrip (what I chose to list xdrip+ app as) and one listed as blank.  One is of the type of entry it is (e.g. meal bolus) and one is just a note.
![double reporting](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/17012342/24993617/0e16acde-201f-11e7-9382-e8720e936ea1.jpg)

First time I've recorded an issue so please let me know what further info you need.

comments.body:
Can you use the System Status menu item and tell me the version code of xDrip that you are using and reporting this bug with?

Thanks

It's 673462a-2017.01.20 code 1701201513

Although it happened occasionally with a previous version, but this is
consistently all the time now.

input and the 3.9 is a compression low, they just happen to coincide at the
